items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: So anyhow, so my friend brought it to Charlie Mingus, he liked it and he put it out.

ctx.x: Yeah. I don’t think he’s around anymore. So anyhow, so my friend brought it to Charlie Mingus, he liked it and he put it out. And so that started something. I think that was before I had, then I don’t remember what happened but I got four albums out on Bethlehem. I don’t know if you know anything about those?
